notes.title: From the mind of YOKO TARO: The Voice of Cards Trilogy is on sale now!
notes.content:
The Voice of Cards series are quirky RPGs where the whole world is depicted through the medium of cards.

Voice of Cards Trilogy brings together all three games from the series; “The Isle Dragon Roars”, “The Forsaken Maiden” and “The Beasts of Burden” in one extra-value set.

In the Voice of Cards games you will experience the atmosphere of playing a tabletop RPG, listening to narration by the game master along the way, and with the outcomes of events and battles occasionally resting on the fall of the dice.
Each of the games in the trilogy is based in the same setting, but their respective stories are completely unconnected, so you are free to start from whichever one you please.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30738/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41258953/4f874a7503ea925a404d6d3bd229d4f66e2ebc37.png[/img][/url]

Bringing you a new, yet nostalgic gaming experience from YOKO Taro (Creative director) , Okabe Keiichi (Music director) and Fujisaka Kimihiko (Character designer).

A “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” is also available, containing DLC that lets you change the designs of in-game items such as card backs and playing pieces to a theme based on YOKO Taro's other works, as well as DLC to change the BGM and the illustrations to a pixel art style.

*The various content included in “Voice of Cards Trilogy” and “Voice of Cards Trilogy + DLC set” are identical to the same items sold separately. Please take care to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Please be aware that services requiring an internet connection may be closed down after a set time has passed from the game’s release.

YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka present the story of a girl who swears revenge on monsters.

Those who purchase the game by 3 October 2022 16:00 (UTC) will receive early purchase bonus DLC items!

What is “Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden”?
In a world where “monsters” roam the land.
Humans and monsters were in constant conflict.

A girl who lost what is precious to her in a monster attack.
A boy who leads her by the hand.

Together, they discover the woreld and find something that is truly irreplaceable...

notes.title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is out now!
notes.content:
Set sail on a voyage to change destiny itself.

The second game in the unique Voice of Cards series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

A touching tale set in a world of melancholic beauty, brought to you by the creative minds of YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41901909/64e2025bfb7e74748e964ffd2a52617a2e9ebe46.png[/img]

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is available individually or as a deluxe edition with DLC. This product is a set containing the game: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden, as well as multiple DLC releases that can change the appearance of in-game components like  cards and avatars to designs based on YOKO TARO's other works and change the appearance of all character and monster illustrations to a pixel art style.

Don't miss the early purchase incentives - Offer available until March 7th 5pm UTC!

*This game is not a direct sequel to Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars. Both stories can be enjoyed as standalone game experiences.

notes.content:

notes.title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is now coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is set on a remote chain of islands that have been protected by the maidens for generations, but which now face destruction. The hero of the story vows to save the islanders and sets sail for the high seas, together with Laty, a girl who failed to become a maiden.

The second game in the unique Voice of Cards series, where all elements are presented entirely through the medium of cards, in the tradition of tabletop RPGs and gamebooks.

A touching tale set in a world of melancholic beauty, brought to you by the creative minds of YOKO TARO, Keiichi Okabe and Kimihiko Fujisaka.

This game is not a direct sequel to Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars. Both stories can be enjoyed as standalone game experiences.

Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden is available individually or as a deluxe edition with DLC - now available for pre-order  as well!
This product is a set containing the game: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden, as well as multiple DLC releases that can change the appearance of in-game components like  cards and avatars to designs based on YOKO TARO's other works and change the appearance of all character and monster illustrations to a pixel art style.

Enjoy the early purchase incentives: DLC which replaces the design on the backs of the cards, and DLC that alters the design of the game table. Don't miss out - Offer available until March 7th 5pm UTC!
